source_text: In septimana qua sequestrata est Maria, castra non moventur. Nullus profectus donec mundetur Maria. Post purgationem populus proficiscitur a domibus memorialibus. Cui gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: In week in-which set-apart is Miriam, camps not are-moved. No progress until is-cleansed Miriam. After cleansing people sets-out from houses of-memorial. To-whom glory unto ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: In the week Miriam is set apart, the camp does not move. There is no advance until Miriam is cleansed. After her cleansing the people set out from the memorial houses. To whom be glory forever. Amen.
